title: Stuffed Onions
instructions: Fill a pot halfway with water. Slit the onions halfway and place in the pot; cover and boil for about 20-25 minutes. Drain the water and wait until cool.
Meanwhile, wash the rice and mix well with the veal, pepper, salt, cilantro, and water.
Once the onions are cool, stuff them with the mixture.
For the sauce: add 2-3 tbsp oil to a pot and heat, then add the remaining small onions (what you didn't use for stuffing) and cook until browned. Add the chicken necks and brown them.
Add 1 cup water, 1 tsp salt, pepper, half the garbanzo beans, then half the stuffed onions, then the rest of the garbanzo beans, then the rest of the onions.
Place a plate on top. Once boiled, lower the heat and leave it for 3 hours — make sure it slow-boils.
notes: Also called Osh Pyozee. Doc updated salt from 1 tbsp to 1 tsp.
